decisions.reason: Despite two years without website visibility, this close-to-core handcrafted line can be carried at relatively low cost, so we keep the option open a bit longer.
As a straightforward variation within the firm's core Christmas pyramid business, it still fits existing capabilities and is inexpensive to retain unless clearer failure appears.
After several seasons and no recent website presence, the more electronics-based flagship now looks sufficiently tested and too far from the firm's craft-based core to justify further commitment.
Because this add-on depends on the electronic music box and has weak standalone logic for a traditional woodcraft firm, we release the resources to the established range and new development.
